segments.title: Chương 87: 0087 【Hoàng Đô, Tao Đến Rồi】
segments.content:
In 2004, Rongcheng had only one airport, Shuangliu Airport.

Before the two even arrived, Bian Guanyue was being bombarded with calls from her dad.

She didn't want her father to see her off, but he insisted on coming and had already arrived at the airport ahead of time.

"I'm entering the terminal building."

"I'm right near the entrance."

Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue continued inside and soon saw a family of three.

Bian Guanyue's stepmother and her half-brother had come as well.

Afraid of upsetting his daughter, Bian Jinsong quickly explained, "Your auntie also means well…"

"Okay. Hello, Auntie."

Bian Guanyue's emotions were calm. She even offered a greeting, not wanting Chen Guiliang to see her lose her composure.

This greeting was a pleasant surprise for Bian Jinsong.

But his daughter's behavior was too abnormal, and Bian Jinsong quickly guessed what was going on. He shook Chen Guiliang's hand enthusiastically, "Young man, I've heard of your great name even in Rongcheng. A young talent, I wish you a bright and limitless future."

"Thank you, Uncle. I wish you prosperous business," Chen Guiliang responded with a smile.

Bian Guanyue's stepmother also greeted him warmly, even helping Chen Guiliang with his suitcase. She didn't look like a wicked stepmother at all. On the contrary… she was very kind and amiable.

The woman was already a bit plump, but one could still tell she had been a beauty in her youth.

The little boy by her side was about 10 years old, looking very well-behaved and clever.

After completing the check-in procedures, Bian Jinsong saw his daughter's indifferent attitude and pulled Chen Guiliang aside to chat enthusiastically.

Bian Guanyue wasn't cold to everyone. She actually had a decent relationship with her little brother and took him to wander around nearby.

"Want to go to the restroom for a smoke?" Bian Jinsong asked.

Smoking was the pretense; talking privately was the real reason.

Chen Guiliang nodded. "Okay."

The two went to the restroom. Bian Jinsong said, "Guanguan can be stubborn sometimes, you have to be a little more patient with her."

"She has a very good personality," Chen Guiliang said truthfully.

Especially after they had grown closer, Bian Guanyue went along with whatever Chen Guiliang wanted. She was even a bit careful, afraid of making him unhappy.

Bian Jinsong added, "I specifically looked it up. Peking University is less than 20 kilometers from the Capital University of Economics and Business. If Guanguan needs anything, I'll have to trouble you to take care of her. If you run into any trouble you can't handle, just give me a quiet call. Here, take down my number."

Chen Guiliang took out his phone to save the number. "Once I get a new SIM card in Beijing, I'll call you, Uncle."

Once the number was saved, their relationship seemed to grow much closer.

Bian Jinsong asked with a smile, "Do you have any plans for the future? I saw in the paper that you want to earn a hundred million in university?"

"The reporters were annoying me that day, so I was just spouting nonsense to them," Chen Guiliang fibbed.

Bian Jinsong said, "After you graduate from Peking University, if you think my company is worthy, I would welcome you to work for me with open arms. If you need investment to start a business, you can also come to me anytime."

Was this the modern version of snatching a son-in-law right after the imperial exams?

"Thank you for thinking so highly of me, Uncle," Chen Guiliang said, his attitude ambiguous.

After chatting for a while, Chen Guiliang went to go through security with Bian Guanyue.

Watching his daughter's retreating figure, Bian Jinsong had mixed feelings.

"That young man isn't bad," his current wife said from the side.

Bian Jinsong said, "Children from poor families mature early. That kid is very mature and steady. And he's deliberately keeping his distance from me."

The woman, "Heh."

They landed at Capital Airport at three in the afternoon.

Bian Guanyue had been in a cheerful mood ever since the plane took off, and she became even more lively after landing in Beijing.

Away from Sichuan, she seemed to feel as free as a bird in the vast sky.

After collecting their luggage, Chen Guiliang asked a staff member and learned that Capital Airport didn't have a subway line yet.

To get to the Capital University of Economics and Business, they had to take the airport bus first and then transfer after reaching the city. Or they could take a taxi directly from the airport, which would cost over a hundred yuan.

They were dragging luggage, so they didn't want to bother with transferring.

Chen Guiliang took Bian Guanyue and got into a taxi.

"Driver, Capital University of Economics and Business."

"You two must be first-year students, right? You're quite early."

"Driver, just drive with peace of mind. Don't take advantage of us being freshmen and take the long way. If you do, we won't have to go to the university. We'll have to trouble you to drive us straight to the police station instead."

"Alrighty, no need for you youngsters to be overthinking things! I've been driving for so many years, I never do that kind of scamming stuff. Do I look like that kind of guy to you?"

"I'd say you look a lot like one."

"Hey…"

In those days, it was standard practice for taxis to take the long way with out-of-towners. If they didn't, it meant you'd met a good person.

Chen Guiliang bantered with the driver, and Bian Guanyue, sitting beside them, couldn't get a word in.

When they arrived outside the CUEB campus, he checked his watch. The fare was over 170 yuan.

He definitely took the long way, but not by too much.

There wasn't enough time, so Chen Guiliang couldn't be bothered to argue with the driver.

"Are you two first-year students?"

As soon as they reached the school gate, some older students who were welcoming new arrivals greeted them enthusiastically.

Who doesn't like a handsome guy and a pretty girl, seniors?

Chen Guiliang was now 136 jin, with a well-proportioned figure for his 1.8-meter height, and he exuded an air different from that of a student.

Bian Guanyue had put on makeup especially for today. She did it for Chen Guiliang to see. Usually, her bare face was like a lotus flower emerging from clear water; now, she had an added touch of glamorous charm.

Those few seniors looked as if they had spotted prey, their eyes lighting up as they rushed over!

Bian Guanyue leaned a little closer to Chen Guiliang. "I'm in Public Administration."

"I'm from Public Administration too. My name is Ding Yang. Junior, let me help you with a piece of luggage," a senior said, rushing forward and reaching for a suitcase.

Chen Guiliang stepped forward to block him. "That's not necessary."

The senior gave an awkward smile, realizing the girl was taken and that he probably had no chance.

Another female senior asked, "Junior, what's your major? You look a little familiar."

Chen Guiliang smiled. "It's normal to find me familiar. People often say I look like Andy Lau, but I think I look more like Takeshi Kaneshiro."

"Hahahaha!"

The senior burst out laughing, finding Chen Guiliang more and more agreeable the longer she looked at him.

Chen Guiliang asked, "Where on campus can I get a phone card?"

"I'll take you there," the senior said.

The other seniors didn't follow, because Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue acted like a couple.

There were plenty of first-year students, so there was no need for them to bother someone who was already taken.

As they walked, Chen Guiliang asked, "Senior, what's your major?"

The senior replied, "My name is He Qinqin. I'm a sophomore in International Trade. What about you, junior?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I'm registered for Law."

Bian Guanyue pursed her lips, hiding a smile.

After walking for a bit, He Qinqin pointed ahead and said, "Those tents over there are all for getting phones and SIM cards."

Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue walked into a China Mobile booth and both took out their phones to change cards.

In 2004, when changing your phone service location, you couldn't keep your original number. You had to get a new local one.

As they were picking and choosing, Chen Guiliang spotted a number ending in four 6s. However, the numbers before the 6s were 47, which sounded like "time of death," not very auspicious.

This one will do.

He Qinqin carefully observed their clothes, her gaze particularly lingering on Bian Guanyue's laptop bag.

A rich girl.

In those days, not many freshmen brought a laptop to school, and she was even using a chubby Motorola E680.

As for Chen Guiliang, although his clothes were plain and his phone was just a Nokia 1100, he was most likely a low-key rich second-generation kid as well.

"Junior, give me your number, I'll call you," He Qinqin said, looking at the number Chen Guiliang had just picked.

After leaving the mobile booth, Chen Guiliang saved the senior's number. "My name is Chen Guiliang, a freshman at Peking University."

"You're not from our school?"

He Qinqin was surprised, then looked puzzled. "That name, Chen Guiliang, sounds so familiar. I think I've heard it somewhere before."

Chen Guiliang pointed at Bian Guanyue. "I'll have to trouble you to look after my classmate, Senior. Call me if anything comes up."

"Sure." He Qinqin thought it wouldn't hurt to know a student from Peking University.

Bian Guanyue said, "It's getting late. If you delay any longer, it'll be dark by the time you get to Peking University. I can handle the rest myself."

"It's fine. I'll walk with you for a bit and get familiar with the campus," Chen Guiliang said.

Bian Guanyue didn't refuse again, a sweet feeling blooming in her heart.

He Qinqin stood to the side, feeling like she was being force-fed a public display of affection.

By the time they went to complete the registration, the new student registration office was about to close.

Chen Guiliang left his own suitcase with the dorm manager and helped Bian Guanyue carry her luggage and bedding.

It was a six-person dorm room. Judging by the beds, four people had already arrived.

But Bian Guanyue's roommates weren't around, probably eating dinner at this time, so Chen Guiliang decided to take her to dinner as well.

Seeing Chen Guiliang focused on his meal, Bian Guanyue hesitated for a long time before mustering the courage to put some food on his plate. After placing a piece of meat there, she immediately went back to shoveling her own rice, as if she hadn't done anything at all just now.

Chen Guiliang smiled.

"It's so late, you probably can't register anymore, can you? Do you need to stay at a hotel?" Bian Guanyue asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "It's not that much trouble. I'll just find a random dorm at Peking University, show my admission letter to the dorm manager, and they'll arrange a temporary vacant room for me."

Bian Guanyue said with admiration, "You always have a way no matter where you go, you're amazing! If it were me, I'd definitely be staying in a hotel outside campus."

Chen Guiliang said, "Actually, you're very outstanding, but you're a bit too reserved. You're timid when you encounter people or situations. You need to be confident, you know?"

"Mmm," Bian Guanyue nodded seriously.

After dinner, the two went for a short walk.

Bian Guanyue was afraid of delaying Chen Guiliang for too long and urged him to hurry up and take a taxi to Peking University.

Once in the taxi, Chen Guiliang started sending text messages to his old contacts, "This is Chen Guiliang. I've arrived in Beijing. This is my new number..."

He soon received a bunch of replies.

"Congratulations on getting into a prestigious university."

"Keep it up."

"How much of your history novel have you written?"

"Senior, I'll definitely get into Peking University. I'm already working hard on my summer homework."

"..."

Chen Guiliang chatted via text for quite a while. He suddenly noticed the taxi had stopped and looked outside.

Damn, a traffic jam!

He continued texting as the car moved in fits and starts.

Finally, the driver reminded him, "We're almost at the South Gate of Peking University."

Turning to look out the window, Chen Guiliang smiled. "Whoa, this is pretty dirty and messy. So many open-air barbecue stalls."

The driver said, "This is nothing. Wait a few more days when the older students come back. As soon as it gets dark, the whole street will be filled with smoke, just like the alchemist's furnace in the Heavenly Palace."

There were still some older students around; they hadn't gone home for the summer.

At this moment, at the roadside stalls and small street-side restaurants, many parents were eating with first-year students. There were also older and new students gathering, drinking beer, laughing, and eating skewers.

There used to be many internet cafes here, but they were kicked out by the university two years ago.

Chen Guiliang paid and got out of the car. He walked to the South Gate and asked the guard, "Hello, I'm a first-year student. Do you know which building the dorm for the Yuanpei Program is in?"

"No idea," the guard replied.

The guard really didn't know. The first class of the Yuanpei Program only had a few dozen students in total, yet they were scattered across nine different dormitory buildings.

It was a bit more centralized now, but the arrangements changed every year.

Chen Guiliang wasn't in a hurry either. He dragged his suitcase and strolled slowly, taking it as a chance to enjoy the campus scenery at night.

Perhaps because he seemed overly relaxed, he was mistaken for a returning upperclassman.

A boy, also dragging a suitcase, hurried over and asked, "Senior, do you know where the dorm for the Yuanpei Program is?"

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Why are you registering so late at night?"

"There have been a lot of summer storms, and a landslide affected the train line. I was supposed to arrive yesterday," the boy briefly explained. "Do you know where the Yuanpei dorms are? I've asked a lot of people, and they all said they don't know. If I can't find out soon, I'll have to stay in a hotel."

"Follow me." Chen Guiliang's tone was full of confidence, even though he had no clue either.

The boy was overjoyed. "Thanks, Senior!"
